==Polish==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|pl|nade}}

===Etymology===
{{ety|pl|id=above|:inh|zlw-opl:nad<id:above>|text=+|tree=1}}

===Pronunciation===
{{pl-pr|a=pl-nad.ogg|hh=nad-|mp=#|CD=#}}

===Preposition===
{{head|pl|preposition}}

# {{ng|denotes location}}; [[above]], [[over]] {{+obj|pl|ins}}
#: {{syn|pl|ponad|powyżej}}
#: {{cot|pl|pod|popod}}
#: {{uxi|pl|'''Nad''' biurkiem wisi piękny obraz.|'''Above''' the desk hangs a beautiful painting.}}
# {{ng|denotes location, particularly in relation to a body of water}}; [[on]], [[by]] {{+obj|pl|ins}}
#: {{uxi|pl|Mieszkają w dużym domu '''nad''' morzem.|They live in a big house '''by''' the sea.}}
#: {{uxi|pl|Opole leży '''nad''' Odrą.|Opole lies '''on''' the Oder.}}
# {{ng|denotes motion}}; to [[above]], to [[over]] {{+obj|pl|acc}}
#: {{syn|pl|ponad|powyżej}}
#: {{cot|pl|pod|popod}}
#: {{uxi|pl|Podnieś ręce '''nad''' głowę!|Put your hands '''above''' your head!}}
# {{ng|denotes movement, particularly in relation to a body of water}}; [[to]] {{+obj|pl|acc}}
#: {{ant|pl|znad}}
#: {{uxi|pl|W niedzielę jedziemy '''nad''' jezioro.|We're going '''to''' the lake on Sunday.}}
# {{lb|pl|literary|or|dialectal|Chełmno}} {{ng|denotes position in comparison}}; [[than]]; [[over]] {{+obj|pl|acc}}
# [[over]] {{q|indicates relative status, authority or power}} {{+obj|pl|ins}}
#: {{ant|pl|pod}}
#: {{uxi|pl|Nauczyciel umiejętnie panuje '''nad''' klasą.|The teacher skillfully keeps control '''over''' the class.}}
# {{lb|pl|literary}} {{ng|denotes highest degree of intensity of an action or state}};
#: {{syn|pl|ponad}}
#: {{uxi|pl|Kocham to '''nad''' życie.|I love it '''to''' death/'''more than''' life itself/'''more than''' anything in the world.}}
# {{ng|denotes subject of activities}}; [[on]] {{+obj|pl|ins}}
#: {{uxi|pl|Pracuję '''nad''' scenariuszem do nowego filmu.|I'm working '''on''' a script for a new film.}}
# {{ng|with a reduplicated noun, expresses superlative nature}}; [[great|the greatest of all]], [[of]] {{+obj|pl|ins/acc<q:stylized>}}
#: {{uxi|pl|Oj, marzy mi się pizza '''nad''' pizzami!|Oh, I dream of '''the greatest of all''' pizzas!}}
#: {{uxi|pl|Zawisza Czarny, rycerz '''nad''' rycerzami, zginął po wzięciu do tureckiej niewoli.|Zawisza Czarny, a knight '''of''' the knights, was killed after being  captured by the Turks.}}
